_about: The game's prefabs: ready-made assemblies of Jak 3's decor, made by the editor from the user's own extracted levels (no data of the game here: names of levels and decor parts only). Each takes, in its level, the index-th instance of the anchor (a decor prototype, or a piece of the level's shell) and every decor element whose middle is within `margin` meters of it (and `grow`: [below, above] more on each axis), not much larger than that box, but the names `exclude` lists. See src/io/prefab_recipes.h.
